title: Sequence Technology Elevation
description: Add imperative headless ordered side-effect engine and sequence canvas UI technology with playgrounds.
summary:
Elevated sequence into a proper playground technology aligned with DAG/Trinity/Flow patterns.

Two-window layout: Sequence canvas (canvas-only, no nested aside) + Compiled Script writer window in a 65/35 row layout via createDefaultLayout. Effect log moved to Inspection panel Run Log section.

Selection: pointer-up click picking fallback in SequenceSession when DAG handle hits miss node bodies; bidirectional selection via existing controller wiring verified in browser.

Catalogue drag-and-drop: draggable palette items with SEQUENCE_STEP_DRAG_V1_MIME, sequenceStepPaletteTreeDragController, canvas onDrop calling session.addStep at worldFromScreen coordinates.

Extension support: imperative/module/text crate (text.concat, text.uppercase, text.length), composed imperative_module_registry + imperative_catalogue_json in imperative/engine, ImperativeExtensionHost in imperative/core merging Actions + Text catalogue sections.

Verified: cargo test (sequence_core, imperative_engine, imperative_module_text), vitest (sequence-react, sequence-play, imperative-core), browser on :6077 — two windows visible, compiled script in writer, no nested aside.
